a: A secret map to the Silent Library.
An ancient inkwell that absorbs forgotten memories.
A crystal lyre containing the 'Music of Creation'.
An old chronicle about the Mist of Oblivion.

en.q: What is the truth revealed by Silas Vane about the destruction of Finn's childhood home?
a: It vanished naturally due to a cataclysm in the desert.
The 'Mist of Oblivion' was a failed attempt by him to steal the island's primeval history.
It was destroyed by an attack from the Cartographers of Remembrance.
Finn himself accidentally destroyed it with the power of his stories.

en.q: What does Finn decide to do after turning down the offer to join the Cartographers of Remembrance at the end of the story?
a: Return to the Zahar desert to live a nomadic life with the local tribes.
Become the new guardian of the Silent Library in the Ice Peaks.

Travel on Jax's airship to search for more sunken cities in the sea.
